item.description:
Fixed

  • The macOS window picker no longer sometimes highlights or captures a window hidden behind the one under the cursor. Windows are now ranked by their real on-screen stacking order, and invisible helper windows are skipped.
  • The macOS window picker's pixel size now matches the captured image when a window spans displays with different scales.
  • Studio recording now labels its capture picker as Studio, including its accessible mode name and pickers reopened after recording, while ordinary video remains Video.
  • Studio safely displays imported out-of-range gradient directions and preserves single-color gradients when changing direction.
  • Settings paths in macOS help and update guidance now consistently use arrows.
  • The Copilot macOS run button now reports an existing TinyClips instance before building or launching instead of silently leaving an older app running. Quit it after saving work and finishing recordings, then run again.
  • App CI now ignores documentation-only and unrelated Copilot configuration changes while retaining platform source, test, shared fixture, and build-workflow coverage. Windows build/test jobs skip before allocating Windows runners.
  • Team Load now keeps bulk session controls in sync when every issue has an owner, rolls back partially verified session claims, and loads repository labels beyond the first page. Label Undo and closing with a comment now work reliably across detail-view navigation.
  • Team Load Momentum now invalidates in-flight history when tracking changes and clears previous totals when switching selections. Failed loads only fall back to earlier data for the same selection.

Added

  • macOS screenshot editor adds opt-in **Find sensitive text** in the Redact tool's sidebar, using local OCR to suggest emails, phone numbers, and IP addresses. Review and approve or dismiss each highlight, then apply undoable opaque black redactions included in copied and exported images. Suggestions are not exhaustive; always review before sharing.
  • Studio backgrounds now support custom solid and gradient colors, plus adjustable gradient direction on macOS and Windows. The preview and exported video use the same direction.
  • Added GitHub Copilot app run buttons for the macOS app and Windows x64/ARM64 apps, building and launching the current session's checkout on its matching host.
  • Team Load now lets you drag assigned issues between teammates on the home screen, including Copilot, with highlighted drop targets, keyboard movement, and Undo. Moves preserve other assignees and verify the new owner before removing the old one.
  • Team Load now has a light/dark theme toggle beside Refresh, updating the canvas and label colors without reloading.
  • Added the TinyClips Team Load Copilot canvas, showing what each teammate and the Copilot coding agent is working on across the app, website, and marketing repositories. It includes per-person load meters, a Needs an owner triage list, and issue detail with assignee editing: assign to a person or Copilot, and add or remove assignees (including Copilot) on issues that already have an owner, with Undo.
  • Team Load now has a Momentum chart under Needs an owner, tracking daily commits, PRs, and issues opened/completed over 7 (default), 30, or 90 days for the whole team, one person, or everyone. It uses the load-meter colors and caches history for an hour.
  • Team Load people now have a profile, opened from the arrow beside their name, showing their momentum over time alongside everything assigned to them.

Changed

  • The macOS first-run welcome wizard now introduces Studio Mode, explains how to start a separate-layer recording and export an editable project, and shows the current capture shortcuts.
  • Renamed the macOS **Clips Manager** window and menu item to **Clips Library**, matching Windows; the existing window routing remains unchanged.
  • The macOS window picker now shows a clearer highlight with an accent outline, plus a label with the app icon, window title, app name and pixel size. A hint shows the controls: Tab/Shift+Tab cycles windows with VoiceOver announcements, Return captures, and Esc or right-click cancels. Clicking empty space no longer cancels the capture.
  • Studio now defaults on for new installs and returning users without a saved preference. Saved on/off choices are preserved, resetting settings restores Studio on, and the refreshed 2.0 welcome-back introduction explains the default and offers the same switch. Record Video and its shortcut remain ordinary recordings.
  • macOS Screenshot and GIF settings now follow Video's quality and before/after grouping, with GIF recording effects under During Recording and screenshot-only options in collapsed Advanced settings. Existing options and capture behavior are unchanged.
  • Restored the original blue focus-bracket app icons on macOS and Windows, ending the paperclip mascot trial early.
  • Ordinary macOS and Windows CI cancel superseded pull-request runs per workflow; non-PR runs use unique concurrency groups so documentation-only pushes cannot cancel source validation. The Windows test job reuses an architecture-, SDK-, and dependency-scoped NuGet package cache; build-job caches were excluded because transfer overhead outweighed restore savings. Build and test coverage, release, Store publishing, and launch-smoke workflows are unchanged.
  • macOS video settings now group controls into Before Recording, During Recording, and After Recording, with audio offset tucked into collapsed Advanced settings.
  • Team Load issue details now separate the assignee list from the Add and Copilot buttons with extra vertical spacing.
  • Studio now remembers each project's saved location across restarts. **Save Project** (Command-S) updates it; **Save Project As...** (Shift-Command-S) chooses a new location. Opening a saved project links explicit Save back to its original folder, while internal autosave stays local.
  • Studio video export now asks for a filename and destination, starting in the saved project folder or the configured video folder. Confirmed overwrites preserve the previous video if rendering fails or is cancelled, and later project saves preserve exported videos in the project folder.
  • Studio save/export safety checks now protect case variants of local metadata filenames, preserve late unrelated asset collisions, and verify the identity and change version of an approved output before replacing it.
  • Set the macOS app version to **2.0.0** for direct and Mac App Store builds.
